difficulty: hard: flight itinerary, 2 pages, Windows GDI+ via Microsoft Print to PDF, Arial, bare aligned-column segment tables with multi-line cells and layover rows, drawn check boxes, nested numbered list
title: Flight itinerary: Lisbon to Auckland
key_sentences: Please arrive at the airport three hours before each international departure.
Boarding closes forty-five minutes before the scheduled departure of each flight.
Allowance applies per passenger and may differ on flights operated by partner airlines.
We wish you a pleasant journey and look forward to welcoming you on board.

list_items.text: Check that your passport is valid for six months after your arrival date.
Complete the online arrival card 72 hours before landing.
Check in online from 48 hours before departure.
Add the booking reference to your travel insurance.
(a) Name changes are not permitted after ticketing.
(b) Date changes are free up to 24 hours before departure.
(a) A full refund is available within 24 hours of purchase.
(b) After that, a fee of 90 euros applies per passenger.
(a) Keep all receipts if the airline cannot offer meals or a hotel.
(b) Claims must be sent within six months.

notes: Producer: Microsoft Print to PDF (Windows 11 print-to-file driver) fed by System.Drawing.Printing.PrintDocument from Windows PowerShell 5.1: DrawString per visual line and DrawLine/FillRectangle for rules. Fonts: Arial Regular, Bold and Italic; the driver embeds them as TrueType CID fonts with generic names (CIDFont+F1...), not standard-14. Segment tables are bare aligned columns: only a heavier rule above and below the header row; cells of two lines (flight number and operator, city and date) are joined with one space; the layover rows are section rows merged across four columns with their text repeated. Booking block is a header-less borderless 4-column key/value block. Baggage table is a full grid. 'Before you fly' items have DRAWN check boxes (two ticked), so no marker; 'Important information' is a plain-weight 11.5 pt heading; its nested list has typed '1.' and '(a)' markers. Page footers: 'Page n of N'. | Fonts in PDF: embedded: CIDFont+F1, CIDFont+F2, CIDFont+F3
